name: Kuze Kouji
source:
Operations Director for the kidnapping case.

Whenever he gets overly flustered, excited, or panicked, he slips into a childish register, prone to babbling and pitching his voice.

Kuze has a brother ([url=/c141281]Monday[/url]), six years his senior, who despite being nominally mature refuses to get a real job and shows no inclination to settle down with a family. Kuze has been worrying about his shiftless brother for years now; the guy's become a chronic source of consternation.

[Edited from in-game TIPS]
(Kuze and Monday are portrayed by the same actor)
